_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for turning a Notion database into the app's stable internal shape. Notion is treated as an untrusted source: when someone renames or retypes a property, you edit THIS file, not code. Point the `notion` values at whatever your own properties are called — nothing else needs to change.
_dataSourceIdNote: The Notion data source this reads. Replace with your own — see SETUP.md for how to find it. Can also be supplied as the DATA_SOURCE_ID environment variable, which overrides this.
_fieldsNote: Each entry maps an internal key to a Notion property. `aliases` are tried when the primary name is missing, so a rename in Notion degrades to a warning rather than an outage. Change `notion` to match your own database.
_swimlaneMapNote: Maps a raw (lowercased) swimlane option to a canonical lane key, so a rename in Notion does not lose initiatives. Exact case-insensitive matches to a lane key below are handled automatically; only list genuine synonyms here.
_ragMapNote: Maps a raw (lowercased) RAG value to a canonical bucket. Covers emoji and likely text equivalents, so the view survives RAG being retyped from emoji to words.
_excludeStatusNote: The Swimlane tag is the roadmap's inclusion filter — untagged initiatives never appear, so status does not have to do that job. Only 'Discarded' is dropped outright. Deliberately-tagged Done/Measure items stay visible and drop off once they fall outside the rolling window. Add 'Done'/'Measure' here to hide completed work regardless of window.
_baselineTrustNote: A committed date is only a commitment if it was set for THIS initiative. Duplicating a sub-item in Notion copies its committed date, so the copy carries a date it never committed to and would otherwise draw a large, meaningless drift badge. These rules decide when a committed date is NOT trustworthy. The value is never deleted — it is kept, explained on hover, and counted in the data-quality note — but the drift treatment is suppressed. Set a rule to false to stop applying it.
_lanesNote: Lane order (top-to-bottom), colours and background tints. Echoed into the API payload so the front-end renders lanes from here — one place to change order and colour. 'optional' lanes are only drawn when they contain initiatives. Rename these to match your own swimlane options.
